# Claude Code KiCad PCB Designer Skill

> Open-source Claude Code skills for AI-assisted KiCad PCB design automation, from schematic generation through PCB routing, ERC/DRC verification, and manufacturing release.

## Repository
- GitHub: https://github.com/Novin3dp/claude-KiCad-pcb-designer-skill
- License: MIT

## Skills
- **kicad-schematic-generator** — Generate reproducible KiCad 9/10 schematics from Python, including hierarchical sheets, custom symbols, BGA support, ERC verification, netlist checks, and PDF review.
  - Source: skills/kicad-schematic-generator/SKILL.md
- **kicad-pcb-autorouter-workflow** — End-to-end KiCad PCB placement and routing workflow with negotiated-congestion routing, plane/DRC repair, differential-pair routing, length/skew tuning, review, ECO, and manufacturing release.
  - Source: skills/kicad-pcb-autorouter-workflow/SKILL.md

## Documentation
- https://github.com/Novin3dp/claude-KiCad-pcb-designer-skill
- docs/claude-code-kicad-pcb-design.md

## Installation
git clone https://github.com/Novin3dp/claude-KiCad-pcb-designer-skill.git
cd claude-KiCad-pcb-designer-skill
./scripts/install.sh

Manual installation:
cp -r skills/kicad-schematic-generator ~/.claude/skills/
cp -r skills/kicad-pcb-autorouter-workflow ~/.claude/skills/

## Capabilities
- Claude Code PCB design
- Claude Code KiCad automation
- AI-assisted PCB design and PCB layout
- KiCad schematic generation
- KiCad PCB routing and autorouting
- KiCad ERC/DRC automation
- kicad-cli verification
- pcbnew Python automation
- BGA PCB routing and fan-out
- DDR3 PCB design and length/skew matching
- differential-pair routing
- Gerber/BOM/CPL manufacturing release

## Typical workflow
Requirements → schematic → ERC/netcheck → placement → BGA fan-out → power/ground planes → routing → DRC repair → length/skew tuning → independent design review → ECO → manufacturing outputs.

## Compatibility
Designed primarily for Claude Code and KiCad workflows. The skills are packaged as standard SKILL.md directories and can also be consumed by other Agent Skills-compatible tools where supported.
